actual_scope: Specialize the predecessor all-order rank floor pointwise to exact unshifted normalized binary narrow cores at the retained distinct-prime/dyadic/integer-alpha widths.
scope_change_reason: The predecessor expressly leaves prescribed fine-prime parameter nonvanishing open. A common transcendental base plus CRT separates bounded-degree monomials; an even-path trimming lemma supplies degree-controlled minors.
bottleneck_link: Analytic recovery and structural decoder: remove the generic-exception premise at one exact normalized source-core interface, preserving shifted/physical/precision and complete-cost obligations.
stop_rule: Stop after the degree-controlled pointwise theorem, exact source identification and bounded independent checks. Do not extend to physical diagonal gauges, Cp-error margins or a multiplication bound.
evidence: PROOF.md derives pointwise rank >= min(2 ceil((2^g+3)/5),s_min-1) for every order and inverse. Exact exponent-box/trimmed-polynomial/source-identity checks and threshold/noncoprime/similarity/rounding controls are recorded in RESULT.json.

open_questions.question: Can one obtain a source-specific quantitative lower margin for the certified minors?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Exact nonvanishing does not imply robustness at Cp-bit precision.
open_questions.first_step: Bound a retained source polynomial at its exact transcendental base with explicit degree, height and exponent dependence.
open_questions.blocked_by: Gelfond-Schneider as used here gives no useful finite-precision margin.

open_questions.question: Does a comparable all-order rank floor hold for actual shifted, chirped or rounded source blocks?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Ordinary Stein rank is not invariant under the diagonal similarities used to identify the normalized core.
open_questions.first_step: Pin one actual matrix including phases, gauges and coefficient production and prove its displacement claim directly.
open_questions.blocked_by: No physical or rounded rank-transfer theorem is provided.

open_questions.question: Can the prime-degree cap be removed for large groups?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The proved floor saturates at s_min-1 when 2^g is much larger than the source prime scale.
open_questions.first_step: Find a source-aware noncancellation argument beyond the injective CRT exponent box.
open_questions.blocked_by: High-degree polynomial relations among the q_i exist.
